name: AIFIRE.ART
description: 🌟🎨📸🎥🎶 一个“AIGC+PGC”的媒体素材（包括图片、视频、音效、音乐、字体、AI模型等）内容平台，核心的产品能力为：面向内容消费者提供海量的高质的媒体素材内容，提供多维度的信息聚合检索手段（基础分类、专题场景等）帮助消费者快速找到所需素材；面向内容生产者提供AI模型信息、AI提示词（prompts）、字体和相关媒体设计工具。直接竞对产品为 Pixabay，使命是「帮助大家用上最优质的媒体素材」。

name: AIFIRE.ART
description: 🌟🎨📸🎥🎶 A platform for ‘AIGC+PGC’ media content, which includes images, videos, sound effects, music, fonts, AI models, etc. The core product capability is to provide content consumers with a vast array of high-quality media materials and offer multi-dimensional information aggregation and retrieval methods (such as basic categorization, thematic scenarios, etc.) to help consumers find the materials they need. For content producers, it provides AI model information, AI prompts, fonts, and related media design tools. The direct competitor is Pixabay, with the mission of ‘helping everyone use the highest quality media materials.’
